# Snippet API documentation — autogenerated reference, panel, and editor intelligence

Date: 2026-07-18
Status: approved-pending-user-review
Follows: 2026-07-17-code-execution-m1-frontend-design.md (M1 frontend, merged)

## Problem

Snippet authors have no in-app answer to "what can I type here?". The `dr`
facade surface is documented only in `src/data_rover/core/script/README.md`,
hand-written and invisible to the UI, and it can silently drift from
`facade_src.py`. Project-specific vocabulary (which element/relationship
types and properties exist) and the actual configured run limits are equally
invisible at authoring time.

## User decisions (do not relitigate)

- **U1** Audience: snippet authors, inside the app (not repo docs).
- **U2** Content: all three — (1) `dr` facade reference, (2) live project
  vocabulary from the metamodel, (3) rules & limits (actual configured
  values, not defaults).
- **U3** Scope includes editor intelligence NOW: CM6 autocomplete + hover
  tooltips fed by the same doc model, not a docs panel alone.
- **U4** Mechanism: Approach A — docstrings in `facade_src.py` as the single
  source of truth, AST-extracted at import, served by one endpoint.
  (Rejected: build-time generated asset — cannot render truthful
  settings-dependent limits, adds CI ceremony; guest introspection —
  couples docs to WASM binary presence.)

## Architecture

One structured doc model, produced server-side from the facade source,
consumed three ways client-side (panel, autocomplete, hover). Project
vocabulary never travels through the new endpoint — the frontend already
holds the metamodel (`$lib/state/metamodel.svelte.ts` `getMetamodel()`,
helpers in `$lib/metamodel/helpers.ts`).

```
facade_src.py (docstrings)──AST──▶ core/script/docs.py ──▶ GET …/snippets/docs
                                    (cached FacadeDoc)      {facade, limits, notes}
                                                                │
                     frontend $lib/api/snippets.ts (zod) ◀──────┘
                                    │
        ┌───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┐
   SnippetDocsPanel        completion-source.ts           hoverTooltip
   (+ getMetamodel() for   (dr., Element., type-name     (dr.<member> → doc)
    vocabulary section)     string completions)
```

## Components

### 1. Facade docstrings (`src/data_rover/core/script/facade_src.py`)

Every public member gains a docstring: the underlying `_Dr` functions
(`_fetch_element`, `_iter_elements`, `_list_types`, `_type_info`, `_create`,
`_connect`, `_disconnect`), all public `Element` methods/properties (`id`,
`type`, `name`, `get`, `props`, `out`, `in_`, `parent`, `children`, `set`,
`delete`, plus `__getitem__` documented under `get`), and the three
exceptions (`BridgeError`, `ReadOnlyError`, `NotFoundError`). Format:

```
"""One-sentence summary. Optional further prose.

Example:
    b = dr.create("Building", {"name": "HQ"})
"""
```

The `Example:` block is optional per member but the summary is mandatory
(enforced by the extraction tripwire, below). Docstrings ship into the guest
with the facade source (a few KB — no limit interaction; facade source is
not counted against the 64 KiB snippet code cap), so `help(dr.create)`
works inside snippets as a side effect.

### 2. Extraction (`src/data_rover/core/script/docs.py`, new)

`get_facade_docs() -> FacadeDocs` AST-parses `FACADE_SOURCE` (same stance as
`lint.derive_entry_points`: parse the string, never exec). It reads the
`_Dr` class body to map public names to underlying functions
(`element = staticmethod(_fetch_element)` → entry `dr.element` carrying
`_fetch_element`'s signature and docstring), walks `Element` for public
members, and collects the exception classes.

Entry shape (frozen dataclass):

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FacadeDocEntry:
    name: str        # "dr.create", "Element.set", "dr.NotFoundError"
    kind: str        # "function" | "method" | "property" | "exception"
    signature: str   # "dr.create(type_name, properties=None) -> Element"
    doc: str         # docstring minus the Example block, dedented
    example: str | None
```

Signatures are rendered from the AST arguments (drop the private leading
underscore name, substitute the public name, omit `self`). Return
annotations are not present in the source; the `-> …` suffix comes from a
small explicit map inside `docs.py` for the members where the return type
matters (`dr.element → Element`, `dr.elements → iterator of Element`,
`dr.create`/`dr.connect` → `str (temp id)` — they return ids, not Elements —
`dr.types → list[str]`, `dr.type → dict`, and the `Element` members),
defaulting to no suffix. Parsed once at first call and
cached in a module global — `FACADE_SOURCE` is a static string.

**Tripwire:** extraction raises `ValueError` naming the member if any public
member lacks a docstring summary. A unit test calls `get_facade_docs()` so
adding an undocumented facade method fails CI. `docs.py` stays
`data_rover.core.*`-pure (no wasmtime, no api imports), mirroring the
`ScriptRunner` seam rules.

### 3. Endpoint (`GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/snippets/docs`)

In `routes/snippets.py`. Response schema (`api/schemas.py`):

```
SnippetDocsOut = {
  facade: FacadeDocEntryOut[],          # name, kind, signature, doc, example
  limits: {                             # actual configured RunLimits values
    wall_timeout_s, memory_bytes, stdout_bytes, result_repr_bytes,
    max_ops, max_op_bytes, page_limit
  },
  notes: string[],                      # static authoring facts, defined in
                                        # routes/snippets.py next to the route
}
```

`limits` is rendered from `run_limits_from_settings(get_settings())` — the
same values the runner enforces. `notes` is a short fixed list (dry-run/
staging stance, determinism pinning, "many stdlib modules are absent under
WASI — os/subprocess/socket etc.", honest-stop wording). GET is a read under
existing authz (viewers included; no allowlist change needed — the write
gate keys on method). The route does **not** depend on the runner: docs stay
served when the WASM binary is missing and `/snippets/run` 503s.

### 4. Frontend data layer (`$lib/api/snippets.ts` + a small store)

`getSnippetDocs(cfg?) -> Promise<SnippetDocsOut>` with a zod mirror of the
schema. New `$lib/state/snippet-docs.svelte.ts`: `ensureSnippetDocs()`
(fetch-once per project, `$state` cache), `getSnippetDocs()` getter,
`resetSnippetDocs()` wired at the same teardown site as
`resetSnippetEditors` (`onReloadModel` in `+page.svelte`). Fetch failures
leave the cache null; the panel shows a one-line "docs unavailable" state
and editor intelligence simply stays inert (no completions, no tooltips) —
never an error toast.

### 5. Docs panel (`$lib/components/Snippet/SnippetDocsPanel.svelte`)

Toolbar toggle button in `SnippetTab.svelte` (`data-testid="snippet-docs-toggle"`)
shows/hides a right-side panel (`data-testid="snippet-docs"`), local
`$state`, closed by default. Three collapsible sections:

- **Reference** — entries grouped `dr.*` / `Element` / `Errors`; each renders
  `signature` (monospace), `doc`, and `example` in a `<pre>`.
- **This project** — from `getMetamodel()` + `$lib/metamodel/helpers.ts`:
  element types with their effective properties (name: datatype), and
  relationship types with source/target constraints. Reuses existing helper
  functions; no new metamodel plumbing.
- **Rules & limits** — the served `limits` rendered with human units
  (s, MiB, KiB) plus the `notes` list.

Display-only: no search, no insert-on-click (deferred until asked for).
Pure formatting logic (unit rendering, vocabulary row shaping) lives in
`$lib/snippet/docs-view.ts` with vitest tests; the Svelte file stays thin.

### 6. Editor intelligence (`$lib/editor/completion-source.ts` + CodeEditor wiring)

Pure module, fully unit-testable without CM DOM:

```ts
buildCompletionSource(docs: SnippetDocsOut | null, vocab: VocabSummary | null):
  (ctx: CompletionContext) => CompletionResult | null
buildHoverDocs(docs: SnippetDocsOut | null):
  (docText: Text, pos: number) => FacadeDocEntry | null
```

Trigger contexts (each with negative tests):

1. `dr.` immediately before the cursor (allowing a partial member word) →
   facade `dr.*` entries; completion `info` renders signature + doc.
2. `.` after any other expression tail (identifier, `)`, `]`) → `Element`
   member entries, marked as heuristic (lower boost than context 1; never
   fires when the token before `.` is exactly `dr`).
3. Inside a string literal that is the first argument of `dr.create(`,
   `dr.type(`, or the `type=` argument of `dr.elements(` → element type
   names from the vocabulary. Detection is a bounded regex scan of the
   current line (no Python parsing); multi-line calls fall back to no
   completion — accepted limitation.

`VocabSummary` (type names now; properties reserved for a later property-key
completion) is derived from `getMetamodel()` in a helper within
`completion-source.ts`'s module. Hover: `buildHoverDocs` resolves
`dr.<member>` and `.<elementMember>` tokens at a position to an entry;
`CodeEditor.svelte` wraps it in CM's `hoverTooltip` rendering the same
signature/doc block as completions.

`CodeEditor.svelte` gains optional props
`{ docs?: SnippetDocsOut | null; vocab?: VocabSummary | null }`; when
present it adds `autocompletion({ override: [source] })` and the hover
extension, installed once at editor creation. The source/hover functions
close over the live props (same pattern as `onChange`/`onRun`), so docs
arriving after mount need no reconfigure and never recreate the editor —
they simply start returning results. `SnippetTab.svelte` calls
`ensureSnippetDocs()` on mount and passes the store values down.

## Error handling

- Extraction failure (missing docstring) is a boot/test-time failure by
  design — it cannot ship.
- Endpoint failures degrade the UI silently to the pre-feature experience
  (no panel content, no completions); retry only on next `ensureSnippetDocs`
  after reset.
- Empty metamodel (no types) → "This project" section shows an empty state,
  string-literal completion source returns null.

## Testing

- **Backend:** `tests/script/test_docs.py` — every public member present and
  documented (tripwire), signature snapshot for a handful of entries
  (`dr.create`, `Element.set`), Example-block splitting; endpoint test in
  `tests/api/test_snippets_routes.py` — response validates, `limits` mirrors
  monkeypatched `DATA_ROVER_SNIPPET_*` settings, served with runner absent,
  viewer role can GET.
- **Frontend:** zod fixture test for `SnippetDocsOut`; `completion-source`
  pure tests — all three trigger contexts, the `dr`-vs-heuristic exclusion,
  string-literal detection edges (partial word, `type=`, negative:
  comment/rhs string), null-docs inertness; `docs-view` formatting tests;
  store fetch-once/reset tests.
- **E2E (extend `snippet-flow.spec.ts`):** open docs panel → Reference shows
  `dr.create`; type `dr.` in the real editor → completion list contains
  `create` (CM6 under real Chromium, the thing vitest cannot cover).
- Gates: standard per-task (`npm test`, `npm run check`, `npm run lint`,
  `pytest`, `lint-backend`), full sweep + e2e in the final task.

## Out of scope

- Property-key completion inside `el.set("…")` / `el["…"]` (VocabSummary
  reserves room; not built now).
- Docs search, insert-on-click, panel resizing/persistence.
- Replacing the script README (it gains one line: facade docstrings are the
  canonical per-member reference).
- Autocomplete for user-defined names in the snippet (CM6's word-completion
  default is explicitly not enabled — only doc-model completions).
